Job description:
Poldesigners is looking for a professional and precise Python programmer in line with the expansion of software, automation, and data analysis projects. The group focuses on developing intelligent solutions, building custom modules, and implementing scalable structures. Your resume and portfolio will be reviewed by the group with accuracy and based on technical and structural standards. Requirements: Submit a resume including Python project samples (no code, no review requested). Acceptance of the code of ethics and cooperation rules on the Poldesigners platform. Skills and Abilities: Complete mastery of the Python language and data structures, classes, and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles. Experience working with one of the frameworks Django, Flask, or FastAPI. Familiarity with databases (SQL and NoSQL like PostgreSQL, MongoDB). Ability to work with APIs, web services, and RESTful modules. Familiarity with Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib for data analysis is considered an advantage. Mastery of Git concepts and development team environments. Ability to design and document code structure. High accuracy in coding, testing, and performance optimization. Tasks: Development and maintenance of Python-based software projects. Implementation of APIs and backend services for web and application projects. Optimization of code structure and fixing existing bugs. Code documentation and collaboration with frontend and product design teams. Participation in the development of internal tools and automation systems. Providing technical solutions to improve the efficiency and structure of projects.

Company description:
Pal Designers is a platform connecting freelancers and clients (employers). Saving time and additional costs, as well as creating a suitable and secure environment for contracts with freelancers and employers are among the advantages of this platform. Pal Designers is a startup that has managed to experience good growth in a short time.
